name: Wuba Intelligent
summary: Wuba Intelligent is a Hangzhou developer and manufacturer of embodied-intelligence robots. Its official portfolio includes humanoid and quadrupedal robot platforms, together with development, manufacturing, testing and training services. The company is part of China North Industries Group and presents the Dasheng D12 as a full-size general-purpose humanoid for service and industrial applications.
